ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.title: Arale
ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.description: The vocalist of Mugendai MewType. A girl who loves anime and manga, especially Magic Lulu. She firmly believes that dreams are power.
ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.cardsModifierD: Arale's cards now appear in rewards and shops.
ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.bestiaryQuote: I've never seen a monster like this... in this manga.
ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.goldMonologue: [sine]How many volumes of Magic Lulu could I buy with this money...?[/sine]
